note: Covered walkway 'Calle Elena' through the terrace; it is the narrow 3 m x 9 m strip outline running WSW-ENE (axis about 240/060 deg). Round arch at each end, house doors both sides, pendant lantern, pebble mosaic in floor.
Tile street sign 'CALLE ELENA 18 36' on the north wall of the passage, about 1.5 m in from the east arch, above the 'agua potable' hatch. ('CASA WILKES' house plaque is by the next door west.)
Large terracotta pot with shrub, inside the passage against the north pillar of the west arch.
Matching terracotta pot with shrub against the south pillar of the west arch.
Spiky rosette on a trunk in the bed on the south (left) side of the small court just west of the passage arch.
Mature magnolia (round dark crown) in the hedge-edged bed directly opposite the east arch of the passage, about 6 m beyond it, in front of the white patio wall. Also the far tree in IMG_2200.
Second mature magnolia in the same bed, roughly 6 m SSE of the first, same distance from the lane; position along the bed is +/- 3 m.
Giant strelitzia clump (two stems, the western one taller) on the lawn just outside the glass pool fence, south of the pool beside the deck spur that carries ladder o2.
Third life ring, on the south pool fence at the base of the deck spur, immediately pool-side of the strelitzia (also in IMG_2206, IMG_2208).

Tall dark-green lamp post with lantern on the south edge of the E-W lane, at the east side of the mouth of the path that runs SSE, just NW of the corner of the house at the bottom of the patch. Also in IMG_2196 (right foreground) and IMG_2220.
Magenta bougainvillea over the patio wall on the north side of the E-W lane, left (west) of the brown patio door with two steps; seen from above in IMG_2220.
